component: Explicit fixed audio acquisition through the current setup owner

source_review.core_checkpoint: GO by independent peer; no runtime claim
source_review.additional_boundary: HTTP redirect rejection and HTTPError explicitly close their owned response before propagating failure.

contracts.consent: Default remains offline plan; selected --archive manual path remains offline. --download or literal YES after a download plan authorizes only the fixed archive plus existing fixed verification.
contracts.request: Fixed GET URL and fixed headers; HTTPS only, exact github.com/release-assets.githubusercontent.com allowlist; redirect guard runs before connection; no credentials, fragments, alternate ports or control/ambiguous characters.
contracts.response: 200 complete representation, no content range, optional exact single Content-Length, no encoded body; bounded streaming actual byte count and SHA256.
contracts.publication: Existing audio.jobs.publish_new(expected_sha256) rechecks bytes during independent copy; destination must be absent; only own partial dev/inode removed.
contracts.lifecycle: 600-second elapsed transfer budget, 30-second socket timeout, cancellation/transport response closure, temporary archive retained through existing prepare_local/final verifier and cleanup before success.
contracts.scope: No engine/library preference activation, runtime source/format change, new process owner, external input deletion or alternate generic downloader.
contracts.rights: BtbN and Gyan identities remain distinct. Complete transitive corresponding sources and public redistribution remain NOT_CLEARED.

tests.network_mode: offline: real urllib pipeline with only HTTPS I/O substituted
tests.source_and_installed: NOT_RUN; current main gate owns selection and exact source/wheel identity

main_workflow_integration.original:
$pin = & $env:CARR_PYTHON -c "import json; from carr_library.audio.runtime import FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_URL,FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_SHA256,FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_BYTES; print(json.dumps(dict(url=FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_URL,sha256=FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_SHA256,size=FFMPEG_ARCHIVE_BYTES)))" | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $archive = Join-Path $audioRoot 'ffmpeg-pinned.zip'
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $pin.url -OutFile $archive
          if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $archive).Length -ne $pin.size -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $pin.sha256) { throw 'Pinned FFmpeg archive mismatch.' }
          $audioWork = Join-Path $audioRoot 'explicit-local-audio'
          $audioBin = Join-Path $audioWork 'runtime'
          & $env:CARR_PYTHON packaging/setup_local_audio.py --archive $archive --destination $audioWork --prepare | Tee-Object 'ci-results/local-audio-setup.txt'

timeout.step: Prepare the sealed local FFmpeg runtime before audio regressions
timeout.reason: The explicit transfer has a 600-second elapsed budget plus a 30-second socket bound; existing fixed native probes and preparation follow in the same step.

validation_receipts_required: Source/installed exact declared test populations as selected by root's current gate.
The existing main setup step's local-audio-setup.txt records downloaded fixed bytes and prepared runtime; verify_runtime is independently read back into audio-runtime.json.
Failure/timeout/cleanup error remains failure. No second acquisition workflow or duplicated runtime pipeline.
limitations: No local executor, compilation or pytest was available while authoring.
Transport fixtures are not real TLS or external-download evidence.
Native validation means only the existing fixed FFmpeg/ffprobe/ffplay version/filter/license probes, not speech, quality, physical playback or NVDA.
Private Gyan runtime preparation is not a complete corresponding-source or public redistribution clearance.
